The live `crimes scan --format json` confirms a medium-severity `near_duplicate_block`:

- `src/sanitize-a.ts:10–36` — `sanitizeUserInput`
- `src/sanitize-b.ts:9–35` — `sanitizeText`
- `src/sanitize-c.ts:9–35` — `cleanMessage`

The functions differ only in names, so the consolidation needs no configuration options.

### Proposed API

Add a canonical module with one pure function:

```ts
// src/sanitize.ts
export function sanitizeText(
  input: string | null | undefined,
): string;
```

The widened input type documents the null/undefined behavior already implemented. The function should retain the current trimming, control-character removal, whitespace normalization, length cap, rejection checks, and uppercase normalization.

Preserve existing exports as aliases to avoid breaking consumers:

```ts
// sanitize-a.ts
export { sanitizeText as sanitizeUserInput } from "./sanitize.js";

// sanitize-b.ts
export { sanitizeText } from "./sanitize.js";

// sanitize-c.ts
export { sanitizeText as cleanMessage } from "./sanitize.js";
```
